_doc: How and when the assistant acts. Decisions by the player, 2026-10-16.
Nothing here is an alert: anything automatable is simply done at the start of every player turn.
When every automation for the turn is finished, a small always-on-top widget switches to 'your turn' (player's choice over a sound).
_close_notices_during_turn: During your own turn, event notices are closed as they come (never decisions), only while the game is the window in front (player request, 2026-10-17).

schedule._masterplans: Thanquol's Masterplans (assist/masterplans.py, strategy/masterplans.json): Steal-Takes on every free Underling and Clan Scruten Secrets. End of turn only (player decision, 2026-10-18): an Underling you send on a Kill-Stab during your turn is never taken first. Before buildings, so a completed Steal-Take's gold is spent the same turn.
schedule._doc: turn_start runs when your turn starts. end_turn runs when you press Build & End Turn in the app, right before it presses End Turn, so settlements taken during the turn are built on the same turn (player decision, 2026-10-16). Buildings stay before the army step: buildings take precedence for the gold (confirmed by the player 2026-10-23, after Thanquol's army waited ~15 turns for refills: 'the faster the economy grows in size, the faster subsequent armies can be afforded and built'). If a turn is ended in the game instead, the next turn start runs the end_turn steps too. Tech and skills run at both (2026-10-17): on a campaign's first turn there is no turn start to act on, so research would wait a whole turn, and unspent skill points make the game stop at its End Turn warning (it opens the character panel instead of ending the turn); with nothing to do both steps send no input. rites (commandments + the Dominating Scheme, assist/rites.py) goes first at both: it must be cast before buildings and the army spend the gold (player rule, 2026-10-17). Step names: rites, workshop, tech, skills, masterplans, buildings, army.

_auto_end_turn: true: every turn is ended on its own once the turn-start pass is done. For the second PC of a 2-player test campaign (player plan 2026-10-19): set this to true and both schedule lists to [] and that PC only ends its turns, whatever faction it plays.
_leave_lords_list: true: the turn-start pass ends by opening the Lords & Heroes list (top right), so your first look at the turn shows which lords and heroes still have movement and where they are (player request 2026-10-23).
_settle_frames: After a click the game turned into an action (a command), nothing more is clicked until the game's UI layout in memory has held still this many rendered frames in a row (tools/wait.ui_quiet): the game sets the pace, usually a few frames. Player request 2026-10-23: let the game dictate the speed from memory (a fixed 500 ms settle was too slow).
_camera_pan: How the camera is moved to bring a map label on screen: auto = edge scrolling in multiplayer (no WASD camera there, player note 2026-10-18), WASD otherwise; edge or keys to force one.
_ai_offers: AI diplomacy offers that hold the other factions' turns: ask = left to you (as before); accept_gifts = accepted when they ask at most a Non-Aggression Pact or Trade Agreement and give only gold, a Non-Aggression Pact or a Trade Agreement (2026-10-22). Anything else is left to you.
_pace_ms: A pause after every click and key press of every step (player request 2026-10-18: a tad slower, still visibly faster than a human; a game crash came right after a fast click sequence). (200 for an hour on 2026-10-23, back to 120 once the game-driven settle came in.) 0 turns it off.

tech._first: Researched before the beeline, in this order (player build adjustment, 2026-10-17: Ferocious Plans first). Tech keys, as in the game data.

buildings._rule: true: a settlement next to one held by a faction the player is at war with (per settlement since 2026-10-20) gets no construction, upgrades, repairs or replacements: it is left to the player. false: every settlement is built (player decision 2026-10-23: off by default, to try playing without it). Widget setting "Leave frontline settlements to you".
buildings._repair_rule: Damaged buildings are repaired before any construction or upgrade, but the war block applies to repairs too: no repairs in a province that borders a faction we are at war with or is partly enemy-held (player decision, 2026-10-16).
buildings._ports_and_specials: Never replaced: the port of a port settlement is kept (adopted) whatever it is, a unique port too, and so is the main building; special buildings (landmarks, legendary or unique buildings) are kept as well. Only normal slots are replaced (player rule, 2026-10-17).
buildings._workshop: Forbidden Workshop level 2 (the 3rd Stormfiend Ratling Cannon upgrade) needs a Construction Cavern line building (any level) standing. Since 2026-10-20 the Warp-Turbine Plant (same chain) is on the settlement list for every capital, so the planned one counts and no temporary Cavern is built while it is planned anywhere. Only when no capital plans it is a temporary Cavern still kept for one turn: in a free slot, else an off-list building's slot, else in place of the lowest-priority building on the list (player rule, 2026-10-17).
buildings._off_list_buildings: replace: in a settlement the assistant manages (not frontline), a building that is not on the settlement list is demolished and the planned one is built in its slot; frontline settlements (next to an enemy-held one, per settlement since 2026-10-20) stay entirely yours (player rule, 2026-10-17). ask: leave such buildings alone.

_doc: A tick means 'refill once' (player rule 2026-10-18): only an army missing template units (troops or its Warlock Engineer) can be ticked, and only while the refill is possible (a province recruits the whole template; an engineer is free or the engineer cap has room). The tick clears itself once the army matches the template again.
A ticked army must match the template: units not in it are disbanded once it stands in a recruiting province,
missing units are recruited, and the army is moved to the province that can recruit them.

auto_create: false (player rule 2026-10-18): the player decides when a new army is raised. The dashboard's Army finances show what every army costs now, what a refill would make it cost (units not in the template are disbanded and stop costing) and what the next army would cost with Supply Lines, and whether it is affordable; 'Create new playbook army' (greyed out while a Warpseer, a lord slot or a province recruiting the whole template is missing) raises a Verminlord Warpseer army at once. true: the builder raises one by itself whenever that holds and the income after the ticked refills and the new army stays at or above income_reserve.

Composition (player decision 2026-10-20, pure ranged): 12 Stormfiends (Ratling Cannons) + 6 Warp-Doom Magma-Cannons, which are tall enough to fire over the Stormfiends in front of them; they replace the 6 Stormvermin. Stormfiends come from the Equipment Warpforge, Magma Cannons from the Warp-Turbine Plant, both tier 5, so only a capital holding both recruits the whole template. Stormvermin still in a ticked army are disbanded at its first refill in such a province.
Until a province can recruit the whole template, the missing slots stay empty.

Heroes are separate characters on the map: a recruited Warlock Engineer spawns outside the town that recruited it and must be moved into the lord's army. A free Warlock Engineer counts as available for an army that lacks one (player note, 2026-10-16).

The army only goes to a province for actual units; the engineer never decides where it goes. If it has no engineer and none is free, one is recruited as soon as the faction cap allows (the cap rises +2 per Verminlord Warpseer with Inscrutable Genius), at the settlement nearest the army that can recruit one, and it walks to wherever the army is (player decision, 2026-10-16).
Heroes are never disbanded automatically: an extra hero is reported for the player to remove.
army_builder._template_lord: Playbook armies may be led by Ikit Claw, Thanquol or a Verminlord Warpseer (player decision 2026-10-21: a faction leader left without a playbook army is a lord adding Supply Lines for nothing). New playbook armies are raised as Verminlord Warpseers.
